# Zain Ventures India

> Zain Ventures India runs a daily AC bus between Rourkela (Odisha) and Patna (Bihar), and hires out buses and cars. Based in Rourkela.

## Services

### 1. Rourkela ⇄ Patna bus tickets
- Runs every day, in both directions. One bus each way.
- Rourkela to Patna: leaves 5:30 PM, arrives 6:45 AM the next day.
- Patna to Rourkela: leaves 4:50 PM, arrives 6:05 AM the next day.
- Trip time: 13 hours 15 minutes.
- Stops, in order from Rourkela: Rourkela, Birmitrapur, Simdega, Gumla, Lohardaga, Chatra, Gayaji (Gaya), Jehanabad, Patna.
- States on the route: Odisha, Jharkhand, Bihar.
- Fare: ₹1000 per seat for the full trip. Shorter trips cost less.
- AC bus with 2+2 pushback seats.
- Pay online by UPI or card. The e-ticket is instant.
- Times and fares can change. The booking page shows the current ones for each date.
- Book online: https://fleetmanager.pythonanywhere.com/tickets/zain-ventures-india/
- Book on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/16812393370
- Or call +91 93370 00323.

### 2. Bus and car hire
- AC and non-AC buses, 20 to 50 seats.
- Sedans and SUVs.
- For weddings, tours, pilgrimages and corporate trips.
- Call or WhatsApp +91 93370 00323 with the date, route and group size. We reply with a price.

## Common questions
- How do I book a bus ticket to Patna? Book online on the booking page, or call or WhatsApp +91 93370 00323.
- Where does the bus stop? Rourkela, Birmitrapur, Simdega, Gumla, Lohardaga, Chatra, Gayaji, Jehanabad and Patna.
- Which vehicles can I hire? AC and non-AC buses with 20 to 50 seats, sedans and SUVs.
